projects.title: node-inspect
projects.description: When the old V8 debugging protocol got removed upstream, the CLI debugger of node.js had to be rewritten on top of the new v8-inspector protocol (a subset of CDP). So... I did that. Mostly because it allowed early JS module APIs to land in node that had been introduced into V8 around the same time.

projects.title: Interaction Tier
projects.description: Developed framework and best practices for running global web properties using Node.js.

patents.title: Mobile service applications
patents.description: Techniques for improved mobile application architectures and service communication protocols are discussed herein. Some embodiments may include a mobile device configured for providing a mobile application including multiple service applications. The service applications may execute asynchronously and in separate containers, providing service orientated architecture (SOA)-like services with respect to other portions of the mobile application, or even external applications. The separation of a monolithic mobile application into separate service applications provide advantages in terms of application performance, development, and maintenance. For example, a subset of all service applications may be started up, and executed on demand to improve device resource utilization efficiency.
